channels.name: CLK
channels.purpose: Synchronous bus clock; up to 208 MHz UHS-I SDR104.

channels.name: CMD
channels.purpose: Command/response; 48-bit frames; open-drain in ident, push-pull after.

channels.name: DAT0
channels.purpose: Data line 0; SPI DO; BUSY when LOW during Programming.

channels.name: DAT3 / CD / CS
channels.purpose: Data line 3 (SD); CS (SPI); CD/DAT3 with internal 50 kΩ pull-up.

handshake_pairs.name: CMD_REQ_RESP
handshake_pairs.rule: 48-bit command; card responds in Ncr cycles with R1/R6/R7 (48b) or R2 (136b) or R3 (48b, no CRC).

handshake_pairs.name: DAT_BLOCK_READ
handshake_pairs.rule: Start bit + 512 B + CRC16 + End bit after R1.

handshake_pairs.name: DAT_BLOCK_WRITE
handshake_pairs.rule: Start bit + 512 B + CRC16 + End bit; card returns Data Response Token.

handshake_pairs.name: DAT0_BUSY
handshake_pairs.rule: DAT0 LOW during Programming; HIGH when complete.

handshake_pairs.name: VOLTAGE_SWITCH
handshake_pairs.rule: After CMD11: card pulls CMD/DAT LOW; host stops CLK + switches VDDIO; card releases HIGH within 1 ms.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Host drives CLK at all times during an active transaction. Host issues every command on CMD; card responds within Ncr CLK cycles. DAT direction (host→card for write, card→host for read) depends on the most recent data command. DAT0 LOW signals card busy.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Card responses depend on host commands. Data on DAT is gated by command and only flows after R1. Busy on DAT0 holds host off until programming complete.

ordering_rules.byte_ordering_on_cmd: MSB-first for cmd index, argument, CRC7.
